friction.title: org HTTP pool uses DATABASE_URL (choros_migrator superuser) not choros_app
friction.detail: src/db/org.ts getOrgPool() uses DATABASE_URL which in CI maps to choros_migrator (rolsuper=true, rolbypassrls=true). The HTTP org queries therefore bypass RLS. ADR §3.6 states 'Backed by the choros_app role' and spec NF-1 says 'accessed only via choros_app role (NOBYPASSRLS)'. No deterministic test fails because the fitness:db tests explicitly use appUrl() (choros_app) for RLS validation, and no AC test checks the connection role. In dev mode this is a low-risk shortcut; in prod DATABASE_URL should be a non-superuser role. No separate APP_DATABASE_URL env var is wired for the org HTTP pool unlike pgJobStore which supports APP_DATABASE_URL.
